office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Stephanie Barnard (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Two-term 8th District state representative and ranking member on the House technology and economic development committee; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Representative since 2022; ranking member of Technology, Economic Development and Veterans [S1]
Lists lower taxes and protecting parental rights among her commitments [S1]
Voted Nay on ESSB 6346 (2026 income tax) and on ESHB 1296 (2025) [S2][S3]
